recentItems.title: Live from FAM Studios: Rangga Jones | Infatuated
recentItems.description:
FAM Studios Bangkok – a dedicated community space for budding artists developed in partnership with Cloud11, a Bangkok-based tech collective empowering creators through labs and studios. Hosted at The Corner House – an iconic, 120-year-old building in Bangkok’s historic Talat Noi district.

Pronounced “rung-gah jones,” Singapore-based artist Rangga Jones is quietly turning heads across Southeast Asia, blending pop and R&B with an effortless charm as his music crosses borders. Smooth, dynamic, and impossible to overlook, he is fast becoming a defining voice in the region’s new wave. Infatuated is from his 2nd album Everything I’ve Wanted To Say released in 2025.
